item.title: Networking | US East (Ashburn) | f4c0b86b
item.description:
Mar0409:24 UTC
Resolved - Our engineering teams have applied mitigations to address the service disruption which was affecting multiple Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) services in the US East (Ashburn) region, including the Oracle Cloud Network Infrastructure issue that started at 13:24 UTC on March 3rd. Oracle engineers have validated and confirmed that services functionality has been fully restored. Please contact Oracle Support if you are still experiencing any issues.

Customer Impact: Customers may have experienced connection timeouts, errors, and increased latency when attempting to perform OCI service operations during the impact window.

Further updates will be provided as events warrant.

Start Time : March 03, 2026 13:24 UTC
End Time : March 04, 2026 09:18 UTC
Preliminary Root Cause:
